label: MING IoT Pipeline
info:
Routes MQTT data to InfluxDB.
- Production: sensors/<device-id>/<measurement> and inference/<device-id>/result → raw_telemetry bucket
- Sandbox: the same topics under sandbox/ → sandbox bucket

Payloads: a JSON object (nested objects and arrays are flattened), or a bare number, boolean or text, stored as "value". A "ts", "timestamp" or "time" key (epoch s/ms/µs/ns or ISO 8601) sets the reading's time.

Lines are batched (up to 500, or 1 s after the first) into one write per bucket, through InfluxDB's HTTP API (no contrib nodes needed). Requires the INFLUXDB_TOKEN and INFLUXDB_ORG env vars in the Node-RED container.

name: Production Pipeline → raw_telemetry bucket
info:
Routes sensors/<device-id>/<measurement> and inference/<device-id>/result topics to the 'raw_telemetry' InfluxDB bucket (30d retention).
Sensor readings go to the 'sensor_data' measurement, tagged with 'device' and 'sensor' from the topic.
Inference results go to the 'inference' measurement, tagged with 'device' from the topic.
Data is formatted as InfluxDB Line Protocol and sent via HTTP API.

name: Format for InfluxDB
Sandbox Pipeline → sandbox bucket
info:
Routes sandbox/ topics to the sandbox InfluxDB bucket, through the same Format for InfluxDB node (its second output).
Sensor topics are sandbox/sensors/<device-id>/<measurement>, inference topics sandbox/inference/<device-id>/result.
Use 'make test-sandbox' to publish test data.

label: System 1 Decision Log
info:
Writes System 1 (laya) decisions to the 'ai_events' bucket.
Callers such as n8n's Incident Escalation publish one message per request on system1/decisions/<set>; each answer becomes one 'system1_decision' point, tagged with set, question, choice, caller and checkpoint.
Confirmations and corrections on system1/feedback/<set> become 'system1_feedback' points. States are never logged, only their sha256. The p4n4-system1 subflow (palette: p4n4 AI) calls System 1 from any flow. See p4n4-docs, decisions/system1.md §6.7.

name: system1/decisions/<set> → ai_events bucket
info:
One point per answer. Tags must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$, or the point is dropped with a warning, so series stay bounded by the question sets' menus.
Fields: confidence, abstain, used, set_version, latency_ms, id, revision, subject, state_sha256.

name: Format system1_decision
p4n4-system1
info:
Runs a System 1 (laya) question set on `msg.payload`, the state.

### Inputs
: payload (object) : the set's canonical state, e.g. `{"alert": "..."}` for incident-triage
: set (string) : optional, the question set; defaults to the SET property
: subject (string) : optional, what the decision is about (a device id), for the decision log

### Outputs
: payload (object) : the service's response: `answers.<question>.choice`, `confidence`, `abstain`
: system1 (object) : `{id, set, version, used}`
: error (string) : set on any failure, with a `null` payload

An abstained answer means "no suggestion": treat it like an error. Every answered request is
logged on `system1/decisions/<set>`. Needs `SYSTEM1_API_KEY` in Node-RED's environment, and the
ai stack's `system1` profile. See p4n4-docs, decisions/system1.md.

system1/feedback/<set> → ai_events bucket
info:
One 'system1_feedback' point per confirmation or correction (n8n's Operator Intake publishes them): tags set, question, expected, choice and caller; fields agreed, abstain, set_version and id.
A message that carries its state (a site that opted in) is also appended to /data/system1/feedback/<set>.jsonl in Node-RED's volume, for `p4n4 ai system1 feedback`. States never reach InfluxDB.

name: Format system1_feedback
Example: the p4n4-system1 subflow
info: Click the inject node to run incident-triage on one alert. Needs the ai stack's system1 profile and SYSTEM1_API_KEY in this stack's .env. On any failure msg.error is set and msg.payload is null.
